scope: Canonical browser control foundation only. No actual-browser transport or decoded media qualification in this checkpoint.

control_checks: Independent upstream RFC8032/JCS cross-language signature vector
Ed25519 and P-256 full content verification, trust/lifetime/freshness refusals
Duplicate keys, malformed UTF-8/Unicode, nonfinite numbers and bounded framing
Signed mock transport authentication and durable create ID replay across physical peers
Timeout/cancellation without automatic retry, tampered session refusal, replay and event overflow retirement

remaining: Actual installed browser with production SDK/control and native server
Opus/VP8 capture, packetization, bounded reassembly, decode and rendering
Identified duplex audio/video/data browser/browser and browser/native
Permission/API refusal, background/resume, impairment/loss and teardown
